verdict.rationale: WezTerm's shell-integration docs describe OSC 7 cwd-tracking and custom user vars (wezterm-docs-10, wezterm-docs-20, wezterm-docs-25), but the evidence pack contains no mention of exit-status tracking, command duration, or notifications when long-running commands finish — features other terminals' shell integrations advertise. Missing for 10: documented exit-status capture, command-duration timing, and completion notifications.
